notes.title: What happens after the Last Days of Spring? Is it First Days of Summer?
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone,

Good news! Last Days of Spring will have a sequel! Want even better news? The game is already done and set to be released!

Any of you that have been consistently buying our games know that when we say that we will make a sequel we always do! In this case we decided to finish the game first before announcing it as we did have a few minor setbacks along the way and didn’t want you guys to be disappointed if we didn’t make our initial target.

So the game is done (in terms of production) and what we’re doing now is ironing out as many bugs as we can find so that when we do release it (sometime next week) you all can have as pleasant an experience of it as possible.

As you can see from the screenshots and the blurb for the game, we’ve really raised our game a lot with this one and even if you didn’t 100% love “Last Days of Spring” we really would love it if you all gave this one a go! We really feel that this game was a positive evolution from “Last Days of Spring” on so many levels. For example “Last Days of Spring” was a (mostly) kinetic novel whereas in “Last Days of Spring 2” there are many choices that have a direct impact on which ending you get (there are quite a few this time!). Anyway rather than me repeating what’s on the blurb go ahead and check out the coming soon page for yourself:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/551520

or those of you that are really interested in the production process and thought process behind games like Visual Novels we do recommend you pick up the deluxe edition of this game, as you will get both the soundtrack and the director’s commentary! How cool is that?

So please do check the game out and look out for it next week when we do release it!

Keep being awesome!

The Sapphire Dragon Productions Team

notes.title: Achievements and added features
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

After lots of tweaking and working we have the achievements you all have been eagerly waiting for! Also we put in a new font to give the novel a more modern flair to it and have also addressed the text box issue some of you have mentioned in the reviews. We have also fixed the saving file issue, as well adding the the ability to full screen and access a back log. 

Also changed the blurb description to kinetic novel as we felt the title was more appropriate now that we have recently completed our first full dating sim visual novel, vote on greenlight here:

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=605181957

Happy to hear any feedback and keep being awesome!

The Sapphire Dragon Production Team

Update: Mac users may have to wait a bit longer. Issues have arisen with Mac release.
